pieces.Text: While a creature is under the effects of a xtabay's soporific pollen, the plant may, as a full-round action, occupy the same square as the sleeping creature and slowly sap the life from it.  Every round the xtabay uses this ability, the creature must make DC

Fortitude save or take 1d2 Con damage.  This feeding is curiously painless, and normally isn't enough to waken a foe put to sleep by the plant.  Each round this feeding continues, the sleeping victim can attempt a new DC
